question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: thirteen requests, one per tool the endpoint lists, each a tools/call with arguments carrying only meta['ucp-agent'].profile, the vendor's own published example agent profile, and no other argument at all. No Authorization header and no HTTP signature. A call with no arguments cannot act on anything: the question is only which of them the server refuses for want of a credential.

decoded.gated: 2 of 13 answer HTTP 403 with JSON-RPC error -32000 AuthenticationRequired and the text 'Unauthorized: A valid JWT is required to call <tool>': complete_checkout and get_order
decoded.not-gated: 11 of 13 answer HTTP 200 with isError true and an argument error, 'Missing required arguments: ...': get_checkout, create_checkout, update_checkout, cancel_checkout, get_cart, create_cart, update_cart, cancel_cart, search_catalog, lookup_catalog, get_product
decoded.ordering: the two gated tools were refused although their calls carried no arguments to validate, so the credential check runs before argument validation, not after it
decoded.not-measured: nothing was created, read or completed: every call was rejected at the credential check or at argument validation. Whether a tool that is not gated succeeds when its arguments are valid was not tested

finding: This maps, tool by tool, where the credential gate actually is on one merchant's UCP endpoint, which no vendor page states. Two tools refuse an anonymous caller by name, complete_checkout and get_order; the other eleven, including all five checkout tools but complete_checkout and all four cart tools, take the call and answer an argument error. That is a stronger reading than any single request: the server does refuse anonymous callers, by tool, before it validates arguments, so the absence of a refusal on the other eleven is a measurement and not an ordering accident. It agrees with the vendor's tier table, which grants the Anonymous tier checkout build and edit tools, and disagrees with two prose pages that say checkout requires authentication. One merchant, one minute, the vendor's own store; a merchant could configure this differently, and nothing here shows that any ungated tool succeeds with valid arguments.

reproducibility.command: E=https://1da1f2-7c.myshopify.com/api/ucp/mcp;A='{"meta":{"ucp-agent":{"profile":"https://shopify.dev/ucp/agent-profiles/examples/2026-08-25/valid-with-capabilities.json"}}}';for t in get_checkout create_checkout update_checkout complete_checkout cancel_checkout get_cart create_cart update_cart cancel_cart get_order search_catalog lookup_catalog get_product;do printf "$t ";curl -sS -w' %{http_code}\n' -X POST $E -H'content-type: application/json' -d"{\"jsonrpc\":\"2.0\",\"id\":1,\"method\":\"tools/call\",\"params\":{\"name\":\"$t\",\"arguments\":$A}}";done
